ProDHCPServer 1.1.0 adds a **Look** setting so you can change the whole style of the window, not just light or dark. Everything the app does on the network is unchanged from 1.0.0.

## What's new

- **Look picker** in Settings (the gear button, or Ctrl+,), just above **Dark or light**. Pick one and the window repaints straight away; the choice is remembered next time you open the app.
- **Rack faceplate**: the look you already know. Still the default.
- **Frutiger Aero**: glass panels with a gloss band, glossy round buttons, orb status lights, over a sky full of bubbles and rings. The dark version is black glass over deep teal.
- **Metal Heart**: riveted steel plates with chrome bevels and brushed grain, chrome buttons, lens status lights and a red Start button, over shattered chrome in black, white and red.
- Every look has a dark and a light version, so **Dark or light** (including **System**, which follows Windows) still applies.

Drop-down boxes and text fields keep the standard Windows style in every look, and the window frame is the normal Windows title bar.

## Download

1. Download `ProDHCPServer-v1.1.0-win-x64.exe` below. It's a single file: nothing to install, no .NET runtime needed. Replace your 1.0.0 copy with it; your profiles and settings carry over.
2. Double-click it. Windows asks for administrator rights, because changing adapter settings and serving DHCP need them.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **The exe isn't code-signed yet.** The first time you run it, Windows SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC": click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On IT-managed work laptops, Microsoft Defender's attack surface reduction rules may block it outright. Run it on an unmanaged laptop, or ask IT to allow a fixed folder (for example `C:\Tools\ProDHCPServer\`).

To check the download wasn't corrupted, compare its SHA-256 with the `.sha256` file below. In PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\ProDHCPServer-v1.1.0-win-x64.exe`

## Everything else

The DHCP server, status checks, ping graphs, profiles with manufacturer presets, log export and device discovery are as in [1.0.0](https://github.com/cookingwithsimon/ProDHCPServer/releases/tag/v1.0.0), which also lists the known limits.

Found a problem on site? [Open an issue](https://github.com/cookingwithsimon/ProDHCPServer/issues/new/choose) with the **Problem on site** form and include the session log.
